detail_lines: NAIC is the final International Championships event of the 2026 Championship Series season, providing the last opportunity to earn Championship Points.
The venue is the Ernest N. Morial Convention Center in New Orleans, with the event running from June 12 to 14.
The competition includes four disciplines: VGC (video game), TCG (card game), GO (mobile), and UNITE (team battle).

items.summary_title: Pokémon 30th Anniversary: Official Booth "What's Your Favorite?" at Three Major Conventions in 2026
items.summary: Pokémon will celebrate its 30th anniversary by setting up an official "What's Your Favorite?" booth at three major conventions in 2026: CCXP in Mexico, Comic‑Con International in San Diego, and PokémonXP in San Francisco. The booth will give out limited‑editi…
key_points: Date & Location: Three conventions in 2026 – April (CCXP Mexico, Mexico City), July (Comic‑Con International, San Diego), August (PokémonXP,
Event Content: The official booth will offer multiple Pokémon stickers while supplies last; fans can take them freely, or choose special sti
Participation Effect: The sticker wall and meet‑and‑greet enhance fan engagement, celebrating Pokémon’s 30th anniversary and showcasing fans
detail_lines: The official booth will distribute various Pokémon stickers, limited in quantity and available until they run out; attendees can take them or select special stickers to put on the wall.
There will be a Pikachu and Eevee meet‑and‑greet at the venue, allowing fans to get close for photos and a more interactive experience.
At the end of each day, the stickers on the wall will form a collage, displaying the day’s arrangement and trends of fans' favorite Pokémon.
The convention venues are respectively Centro Banamex in Mexico City, the San Diego Convention Center, and the Moscone Center in San Francisco; all dates have been confirmed.
